name: UGC b-roll · hands only
description: A short hands-only clip of the product being used, with no face and no speech, to cut under a voiceover. Use it when you need filler that matches the rest of an ad.
prompt: Hands-only close-up: {{ action }}. Filmed on a phone from just above, {{ light }}, shallow depth of field, real skin texture, the product label readable and unchanged. Slow steady movement, no camera shake, no face in frame. No text on screen.
negative_prompt: face, on-screen text, watermark, shaky camera, warped label

slots.name: action
slots.label: What the hands do
slots.help: e.g. 'a thumb presses the pump and cream lands on a fingertip'

author: kilnry
